A huge luminous anatomically inspired GLASS HEART sculpture occupies the central stage, translucent ice-blue arteries with tiny flowing light particles and flowing ribbon-like scan lines that suggest motion, beautiful realistic caustics on a deep midnight-blue background. Distinctive, cinematic, expensive 3D motion-design website, not a stock doctor-photo template. No health outcome claims.
